title: BPDU Guard & Root Guard
description: Protect the STP topology: BPDU Guard on access ports, Root Guard on the uplink.
scenario: Protect the STP topology: BPDU Guard on access ports, Root Guard on the uplink.

concepts.title: BPDU Guard
concepts.body: BPDU Guard err-disables any portfast port that receives a BPDU. A host should never send BPDUs — receiving one means someone plugged in a switch.
concepts.code:
SW1(config-if)# spanning-tree portfast
SW1(config-if)# spanning-tree bpduguard enable

concepts.title: Root Guard
concepts.body: Root Guard on an interface blocks superior BPDUs. If a rogue switch tries to become root, the port goes root-inconsistent instead of re-electing a new root.
concepts.code:
SW1(config-if)# spanning-tree guard root
%SPANTREE-2-ROOTGUARD_BLOCK: port Fa0/24 root-inconsistent

concepts.title: BPDU Guard vs Root Guard
concepts.body: BPDU Guard = ANY BPDU shuts the port (use on access ports). Root Guard = only superior BPDUs are blocked (use on uplinks toward non-root switches).
concepts.code:
Access port:  portfast + bpduguard
Uplink port:  guard root
